==English==
{{wp}}
{{rfc|en|The fourth sense 'An act of withdrawing.' collapses many senses of the referenced verb into one, leading to very inconsistent and unpredictable translations.|section=withdrawal;_bad_definition_(4)_and_similarly_bad_translation_box}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:af|withdraw|-al<id:nominal>|text=+|tree=1}}

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/wɪðˈdɹɔː(ə)l/|/wɪθˈdɹɔː(ə)l/|a=RP}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Vealhurl-withdrawal.wav|a=Southern England}}
* {{IPA|en|/wɪðˈdɹɔ(ə)l/|/wɪθˈdɹɔ(ə)l/|a=US}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Wodencafe-withdrawal.wav|a=US}}
* {{IPA|en|/wɪðˈdɹɑ(ə)l/|/wɪθˈdɹɑ(ə)l/|a=cot-caught}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈwɪθˌdɹɔːl/|a=informal,US}}
* {{IPA|en|/wɪðˈdɹɔːɹəl/|/wɪθˈdɹɔːɹəl/|a=intrusive r}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# Receiving from someone's care what one has earlier [[entrusted]] to them. Usually refers to [[money]].
# A method of [[birth control]] which consists of removing the penis from the vagina before ejaculation.
# A type of metabolic [[shock]] the body undergoes when a [[substance]] (such as a [[drug]]) on which a patient is dependent is withheld.
#: ''heroin '''withdrawal'''''
#: ''nicotine '''withdrawal'''''
#: ''caffeine '''withdrawal'''''
# An act of [[withdraw]]ing or a state of being [[withdrawn]].
#* {{RQ:Guardian|author=Adrian Horton|title=All supporting acts withdraw from Ed Sheeran’s tour in solidarity with Macklemore|url=https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/sep/15/ed-sheeran-macklemore-palestine-openers-finneas|date=2026-09-15|passage=The abrupt '''withdrawals''' of Sheeran’s opening acts came hours after the English singer confirmed that Kraft, along with several other stadium owners, refused to allow the tour to play at their venues if Macklemore continued to open for him.|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20260916052133/https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/sep/15/ed-sheeran-macklemore-palestine-openers-finneas}}
# The sum of money taken from a bank account.

====Antonyms====
